scope: Only real force data/particle/label primitives and existing clip/default helpers; no force/stress model layout
notes: FParticle initializes separate displacement/position/size vectors; FBendpoint and FLabel auto-append only to owner edge local lists, not automatically graph-wide lists. FGraph keeps ordered nodes/edges/labels/bendPoints as separate source collections.

FEdge.setSource/setTarget are direct references, not layered edge detach/append setters. Source endpoint clip uses center-to-center vectors and actual source/target sizes, independent of intermediate bendpoints. Actual clipVector source R15 already approved.

Adjacency sums actual directed edge priority, getConnection nodes sums both directional entries; same-edge bendpoint pairs return that edge priority, otherwise0. Do not fabricate label-to-node adjacency or implicit graph counts; literal compiled JS arithmetic preserved without invented wrap.

Bendpoint distribution increments source position sequentially, retaining arithmetic order. Label inline true centers relative source/target/halfsize; otherwise all4 quadrant branches and spacing from edge force property5 kept literal, not generic always-top placement.
ELK fixed worker is sole behavior baseline; readable Java file license corroboration only. Existing primitive/clone/Vec2 helpers reused; no GWT runtime transplant approval.
